description: Run a failed or cancelled document job again with the same settings, from its stored source (kept about 7 days). Pass document_path to wait and save the result there, as the other tools do. COSTS CREDITS like the original job - say so and get agreement first.

document_path.description: The original document, so the result is saved beside it and named after it

job_id.description: The failed or cancelled job to run again

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before returning (default 55)

name: retry_job
title: Retry a job
